DIMENSIONSMOD-VOID.description: Draw X cards. If you draw a card with the same Prefix, gain 1 [gold]Energy[/gold], this only happens one time per card. Different cards are [gold]Exhausted[/gold] upon draw.
DIMENSIONSMOD-VOID.title: Void
DIMENSIONSMOD-EXHUME.description: Put a card from your [gold]Exhaust[/gold] pile into your hand. If it's a [gold]Status[/gold] card, [gold]Purge[/gold] it.
DIMENSIONSMOD-EXHUME.title: Exhume
DIMENSIONSMOD-PURGE.description: Removed until end of combat. Does [red]NOT[/red] go in your [gold]Exhaust[/gold] pile.
DIMENSIONSMOD-PURGE.title: Purge
DIMENSIONSMOD-CONSUME.title: Consume
